Deep in Scotland's Pentland Firth, a grid scale tidal turbine at the MeyGen site just set a massive milestone: over 6.5 years of continuous operation without a single unplanned maintenance stop.
​Operating 40 meters underwater in one of the fastest tidal currents on Earth.
